slides.title: 5 QUESTIONS TO ASK BEFORE ANYONE DRILLS YOUR DOOR
Are you licensed?
slides.body: Ask for a licensed New York State low-voltage contractor. We are one.

slides.title: Will it fit my frame?
slides.body: Narrow aluminum storefront headers need the right bracket. Our locks hold 600 to 1,200 lb, matched to the door.

slides.title: How do people get out?
slides.body: An exit button inside releases the door, and a mag lock releases when power is cut. Ask where the power supply lives.

slides.title: Where does the wire go?
slides.body: Clean and hidden to a dedicated power supply, not stapled along the frame.

slides.title: Is the price in writing?
slides.body: Ours is $1,350 installed: mag lock, keypad, exit button, power supply, wiring, hardware and installation.

slides.title: SAVE THIS FOR LATER
slides.body: Mag lock installation in Marine Park, Brooklyn. Call for a written quote.
